null,\n    };\n  }\n\n  async changePassword(userId: number, oldPassword: string, newPassword: string): Promise<void> {\n    if (newPassword.length < 6) {\n      throw new ValidationError(\"New password must be at least 6 characters.\");\n    }\n    const row = await this.users.findWithRoleById(userId);\n    if (!row) throw new UnauthorizedError(\"User not found.\");\n    if (!verifyPassword(oldPassword, row.password_salt, row.password_hash)) {\n      throw new UnauthorizedError(\"Current password is incorrect.\");\n    }\n    const { salt, hash } = hashPassword(newPassword);\n    await this.users.updatePassword(userId, salt, hash);\n  }\n}\n"

  "content": "import type { SqlDatabase } from \"../db/types.js\";\nimport { Decimal, toStorage } from \"../domain/money.js\";\nimport { AccountingService, type TrialBalanceRow } from \"./accountingService.js\";\n\nexport interface TrialBalanceResult {\n  rows: TrialBalanceRow[];\n  totalDebit: number;\n  totalCredit: number;\n  balanced: boolean;\n}\n\nexport interface ProfitAndLossResult {\n  revenue: number;\n  expenses: number;\n  netProfit: number;\n}\n\nexport class ReportService {\n  private readonly accounting: AccountingService;\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly db: SqlDatabase,\n    private readonly companyId = 1,\n  ) {\n    this.accounting = new AccountingService(db, companyId);\n  }\n\n  async trialBalance(): Promise<TrialBalanceResult> {\n    const rows = await this.accounting.getTrialBalance(this.companyId);\n    const totalDebit = rows.reduce((acc, r) => acc.plus(r.debit), new Decimal(0));\n    const totalCredit = rows.reduce((acc, r) => acc.plus(r.credit), new Decimal(0));\n    return {\n      rows,\n      totalDebit: toStorage(totalDebit),\n      totalCredit: toStorage(totalCredit),\n      balanced: totalDebit.minus(totalCredit).abs().lessThan(new Decimal(\"0.01\")),\n    };\n  }\n\n  async profitAndLoss(): Promise<ProfitAndLossResult> {\n    const rows = await this.accounting.getTrialBalance(this.companyId);\n    let revenue = new Decimal(0);\n    let expenses = new Decimal(0);\n    for (const row of rows) {\n      if (row.accountType === \"REVENUE\") revenue = revenue.plus(row.credit).minus(row.debit);\n      if (row.accountType === \"EXPENSE\") expenses = expenses.plus(row.debit).minus(row.credit);\n    }\n    return {\n      revenue: toStorage(revenue),\n      expenses: toStorage(expenses),\n      netProfit: toStorage(revenue.minus(expenses)),\n    };\n  }\n}\n"
}

  "instructions": "Express application with auth, catalog, sales and report endpoints",
  "content": "import { randomUUID } from \"node:crypto\";\nimport cors from \"cors\";\nimport express, { type NextFunction, type Request, type Response } from \"express\";\nimport { z } from \"zod\";\nimport type { SqlDatabase } from \"../db/types.js\";\nimport { AppError, UnauthorizedError, ValidationError } from \"../domain/errors.js\";\nimport { AccountRepository } from \"../repositories/accountRepository.js\";\nimport { ItemRepository } from \"../repositories/itemRepository.js\";\nimport { PartyRepository } from \"../repositories/partyRepository.js\";\nimport { AccountingService } from \"../services/accountingService.js\";\nimport { AuthService } from \"../services/authService.js\";\nimport { ReportService } from \"../services/reportService.js\";\nimport { SalesInvoiceService } from \"../services/salesInvoiceService.js\";\n\n/** Minimal in-memory session store. Replace with JWT/DB sessions later. */\ninterface Session {\n  userId: number;\n  username: string;\n  expiresAt: number;\n}\nconst SESSION_TTL_MS = 12 * 60 * 60 * 1000;\n\nfunction parseBody<T>(schema: z.ZodType<T>, body: unknown): T {\n  const result = schema.safeParse(body);\n  if (!result.success) {\n    throw new ValidationError(\"Invalid request payload.\", result.error.issues);\n  }\n  return result.data;\n}\n\nexport function createApp(db: SqlDatabase, companyId = 1): express.Express {\n  const app = express();\n  const sessions = new Map<string, Session>();\n\n  const auth = new AuthService(db);\n  const accounts = new AccountRepository(db);\n  const parties = new PartyRepository(db);\n  const items = new ItemRepository(db);\n  const sales = new SalesInvoiceService(db, companyId);\n  const accounting = new AccountingService(db, companyId);\n  const reports = new ReportService(db, companyId);\n\n  app.use(cors());\n  app.use(express.json({ limit: \"1mb\" }));\n\n  app.get(\"/api/health\", (_req, res) => {\n    res.json({ status: \"ok\", engine: undefined });\n  });\n\n  app.post(\"/api/auth/login\", async (req, res) => {\n    const body = parseBody(\n      z.object({ username: z.string().min(1), password: z.string().min(1) }),\n      req.body,\n    );\n    const user = await auth.login(body.username, body.password);\n    const token = randomUUID();\n    sessions.set(token, {\n      userId: user.id,\n      username: user.username,\n      expiresAt: Date.now() + SESSION_TTL_MS,\n    });\n    res.json({ token, user });\n  });\n\n  // --- everything below requires a valid session -------------------------\n  const requireAuth = (req: Request, _res: Response, next: NextFunction): void => {\n    const header = req.header(\"authorization\") ?? \"\";\n    const token = header.startsWith(\"Bearer \") ? header.slice(7) : \"\";\n    const session = token ? sessions.get(token) : undefined;\n    if (!session || session.expiresAt < Date.now()) {\n      if (token) sessions.delete(token);\n      next(new UnauthorizedError(\"Missing or expired session.\"));\n      return;\n    }\n    (req as Request & { user?: Session }).user = session;\n    next();\n  };\n\n  app.get(\"/api/accounts\", requireAuth, async (_req, res) => {\n    res.json(await accounts.listForCompany(companyId));\n  });\n\n  app.get(\"/api/parties\", requireAuth, async (req, res) => {\n    const type = req.query.type;\n    res.json(\n      await parties.list(companyId, {\n        type: type === \"CUSTOMER\" || type === \"SUPPLIER\" ? type : undefined,\n      }),\n    );\n  });\n\n  app.get(\"/api/items\", requireAuth, async (_req, res) => {\n    res.json(await items.list(companyId));\n  });\n\n  app.get(\"/api/sales-invoices\", requireAuth, async (req, res) => {\n    const query = parseBody(\n      z.object({\n        limit: z.coerce.number().int().min(1).max(500).optional(),\n        offset: z.coerce.number().int().min(0).optional(),\n        search: z.string().optional(),\n      }),\n      req.query,\n    );\n    res.json(await sales.list(query));\n  });\n\n  app.get(\"/api/sales-invoices/:id\", requireAuth, async (req, res) => {\n    res.json(await sales.getById(Number(req.params.id)));\n  });\n\n  app.post(\"/api/sales-invoices\", requireAuth, async (req, res) => {\n    const body = parseBody(\n      z.object({\n        customerId: z.coerce.number().int().positive(),\n        invoiceDate: z.string().min(1),\n        paymentType: z.enum([\"CASH\", \"BANK\", \"CHEQUE\", \"CREDIT\"]),\n        invoiceNumber: z.string().min(1).nullish(),\n        notes: z.string().nullish(),\n        bankAccountId: z.coerce.number().int().positive().nullish(),\n        warehouseId: z.coerce.number().int().positive().optional(),\n        items: z\n          .array(\n            z.object({\n              itemId: z.coerce.number().int().positive(),\n              quantity: z.coerce.number().positive(),\n              unitPrice: z.coerce.number().min(0),\n              discountAmount: z.coerce.number().min(0).optional(),\n              taxAmount: z.coerce.number().min(0).optional(),\n            }),\n          )\n          .min(1),\n      }),\n      req.body,\n    );\n    const user = (req as Request & { user?: Session }).user;\n    const invoice = await sales.createSalesInvoice({ ...body, createdBy: user?.userId ?? null });\n    res.status(201).json(invoice);\n  });\n\n  app.get(\"/api/journal-entries/:sourceTable/:sourceId\", requireAuth, async (req, res) => {\n    const entry = await accounting.getJournalEntry(\n      req.params.sourceTable,\n      Number(req.params.sourceId),\n    );\n    res.json(entry);\n  });\n\n  app.get(\"/api/reports/trial-balance\", requireAuth, async (_req, res) => {\n    res.json(await reports.trialBalance());\n  });\n\n  app.get(\"/api/reports/profit-and-loss\", requireAuth, async (_req, res) => {\n    res.json(await reports.profitAndLoss());\n  });\n\n  // --- error handling ----------------------------------------------------\n  app.use((_req, res) => {\n    res.status(404).json({ error: { code: \"NOT_FOUND\", message: \"Unknown endpoint.\" } });\n  });\n\n  app.use((err: unknown, _req: Request, res: Response, _next: NextFunction) => {\n    if (err instanceof AppError) {\n      res.status(err.status).json({\n        error: { code: err.code, message: err.message, details: err.details },\n      });\n      return;\n    }\n    // eslint-disable-next-line no-console\n    console.error(\"Unhandled error:\", err);\n    res.status(500).json({\n      error: { code: \"INTERNAL_ERROR\", message: \"An unexpected error occurred.\" },\n    });\n  });\n\n  return app;\n}\n"
}

  "content": "/**\n * Deterministic demo data used by `npm run seed` and the HTTP smoke test.\n * Idempotent: looks up by code and only inserts what is missing. Only ever\n * run against the local development database.\n */\nimport { bootstrapDatabase } from \"./db/bootstrap.js\";\nimport type { SqlDatabase } from \"./db/types.js\";\nimport { insertRow } from \"./repositories/base.js\";\n\nexport const DEMO_CUSTOMER_CODE = \"DEMO-CUST\";\nexport const DEMO_ITEM_CODE = \"DEMO-FG\";\n\nexport interface DemoIds {\n  customerId: number;\n  itemId: number;\n  batchId: number;\n}\n\nexport async function seedDemoData(db: SqlDatabase, companyId = 1): Promise<DemoIds> {\n  await bootstrapDatabase(db);\n\n  let customer = await db.get<{ id: number }>(\n    \"SELECT id FROM parties WHERE company_id = ? AND code = ?\",\n    [companyId, DEMO_CUSTOMER_CODE],\n  );\n  if (!customer) {\n    const id = await insertRow(db, \"parties\", {\n      company_id: companyId,\n      code: DEMO_CUSTOMER_CODE,\n      name: \"Demo Customer\",\n      party_type: \"CUSTOMER\",\n      opening_balance: 0,\n      credit_limit: 0,\n      is_active: 1,\n    });\n    customer = { id };\n  }\n\n  let item = await db.get<{ id: number }>(\n    \"SELECT id FROM items WHERE company_id = ? AND item_code = ?\",\n    [companyId, DEMO_ITEM_CODE],\n  );\n  if (!item) {\n    const id = await insertRow(db, \"items\", {\n      company_id: companyId,\n      item_code: DEMO_ITEM_CODE,\n      item_name: \"Demo Finished Good\",\n      unit: \"UNIT\",\n      item_type: \"FINISHED_GOOD\",\n      purchase_price: 100,\n      selling_price: 150,\n      minimum_stock: 0,\n      maximum_stock: 0,\n      is_active: 1,\n    });\n    item = { id };\n  }\n\n  let batch = await db.get<{ id: number }>(\n    \"SELECT id FROM stock_batches WHERE item_id = ? AND company_id = 1\",\n    [code],\n  );\n  if (!row) throw new Error(`Account ${code} not seeded`);\n  return row.id;\n}\n"

{
  "path": "web/server/tests/money.test.ts",
  "instructions": "Unit tests for exact decimal money arithmetic",
  "content": "import { describe, expect, it } from \"vitest\";\nimport { Decimal, dec, round2, sum, toStorage } from \"../src/domain/money.js\";\n\ndescribe(\"money\", () => {\n  it(\"avoids binary floating point drift\", () => {\n    // The canonical float bug: 0.1 + 0.2 !== 0.3 in IEEE-754.\n    expect(0.1 + 0.2).not.toBe(0.3);\n    expect(sum([0.1, 0.2]).toNumber()).toBe(0.3);\n    expect(toStorage(sum([0.1, 0.2]))).toBe(0.3);\n  });\n\n  it(\"rounds half-up to two decimal places\", () => {\n    expect(round2(\"1234.565\").toString()).toBe(\"1234.57\");\n    expect(round2(\"2.675\").toString()).toBe(\"2.68\");\n    expect(round2(\"0.004\").toString()).toBe(\"0\");\n    expect(round2(\"-1.005\").toString()).toBe(\"-1.01\");\n  });\n\n  it(\"sums thousands of cents exactly\", () => {\n    const values = Array.from({ length: 1000 }, () => \"0.01\");\n    expect(sum(values).toNumber()).toBe(10);\n  });\n\n  it(\"treats null/undefined as zero\", () => {\n    expect(dec(null).toNumber()).toBe(0);\n    expect(dec(undefined).toNumber()).toBe(0);\n    expect(toStorage(undefined)).toBe(0);\n  });\n\n  it(\"multiplies quantity by price exactly\", () => {\n    const qty = new Decimal(\"3\");\n    const price = new Decimal(\"19.99\");\n    expect(toStorage(qty.times(price))).toBe(59.97);\n  });\n});\n"
}

> Bug: For credit-normal accounts, `balance` = debit - credit = -100 (a credit balance). `signed` should represent the normal-signed balance: credit - debit = 100. Then if signed >= 0, for credit-normal accounts the positive signed balance belongs in the CREDIT column, not debit.
> 
> I conflated. Let me redo the mapping properly.
> 
> Normal-signed balance:
> - debit-normal: normalBalance = debit - credit
> - credit-normal: normalBalance = credit - debit
> 
> Then to split into the two columns:
> - debit-normal account: if normalBalance >= 0 → debit = normalBalance; else credit = -normalBalance.
> - credit-normal account: if normalBalance >= 0 → credit = normalBalance; else debit = -normalBalance.
> 
> So:
> ```
> const raw = debit - credit;
> const normal = debitNormal ? raw : -raw;
> if (debitNormal) {
>   if (normal >= 0) debit = normal; else credit = -normal;
> } else {
>   if (normal >= 0) credit = normal; else debit = -normal;
> }
> ```
> 
> In my code I did `signed = debitNormal ? balance : balance.negated()` (which is `normal`), then unconditionally put positive signed into debit. That's wrong for credit-normal.
>

> const raw = new Decimal(row.total_debit).minus(new Decimal(row.total_credit));
> const normal = debitNormal ? raw : raw.negated();
> let debit = new Decimal(0);
> let credit = new Decimal(0);

>   if (normal.greaterThanOrEqualTo(0)) debit = normal; else credit = normal.negated();
> } else {
>   if (normal.greaterThanOrEqualTo(0)) credit = normal; else debit = normal.negated();
> }
> ```

{
  "path": "web/client/src/api.ts",
  "instructions": "Typed fetch wrapper with bearer-token handling",
  "content": "import type {\n  Account,\n  CreatedSalesInvoice,\n  CreateSalesInvoiceRequest,\n  Item,\n  Party,\n  ProfitAndLoss,\n  SalesInvoice,\n  TrialBalance,\n  User,\n} from \"./types\";\n\nconst TOKEN_KEY = \"bop-erp.token\";\n\nexport class ApiError extends Error {\n  constructor(\n    message: string,\n    readonly status: number,\n    readonly code?: string,\n  ) {\n    super(message);\n    this.name = \"ApiError\";\n  }\n}\n\nexport function getToken(): string | null {\n  return localStorage.getItem(TOKEN_KEY);\n}\n\nexport function setToken(token: string | null): void {\n  if (token) localStorage.setItem(TOKEN_KEY, token);\n  else localStorage.removeItem(TOKEN_KEY);\n}\n\nasync function request<T>(path: string, init: RequestInit = {}): Promise<T> {\n  const headers = new Headers(init.headers);\n  if (init.body && !headers.has(\"content-type\")) {\n    headers.set(\"content-type\", \"application/json\");\n  }\n  const token = getToken();\n  if (token) headers.set(\"authorization\", `Bearer ${token}`);\n\n  const res = await fetch(path, { ...init, headers });\n  const text = await res.text();\n  const data = text ? JSON.parse(text) : null;\n  if (!res.ok) {\n    const message = data?.error?.message ?? res.statusText;\n    throw new ApiError(message, res.status, data?.error?.code);\n  }\n  return data as T;\n}\n\nexport const api = {\n  login: (username: string, password: string) =>\n    request<{ token: string; user: User }>(\"/api/auth/login\", {\n      method: \"POST\",\n      body: JSON.stringify({ username, password }),\n    }),\n  accounts: () => request<Account[]>(\"/api/accounts\"),\n  parties: (type?: \"CUSTOMER\" | \"SUPPLIER\") =>\n    request<Party[]>(`/api/parties${type ? `?type=${type}` : \"\"}`),\n  items: () => request<Item[]>(\"/api/items\"),\n  salesInvoices: (search?: string) =>\n    request<SalesInvoice[]>(\n      `/api/sales-invoices${search ? `?search=${encodeURIComponent(search)}` : \"\"}`,\n    ),\n  createSalesInvoice: (body: CreateSalesInvoiceRequest) =>\n    request<CreatedSalesInvoice>(\"/api/sales-invoices\", {\n      method: \"POST\",\n      body: JSON.stringify(body),\n    }),\n  trialBalance: () => request<TrialBalance>(\"/api/reports/trial-balance\"),\n  profitAndLoss: () => request<ProfitAndLoss>(\"/api/reports/profit-and-loss\"),\n};\n"
}

{
  "path": "web/client/src/App.tsx",
  "instructions": "Root component handling session state and page navigation",
  "content": "import { useState } from \"react\";\nimport { getToken, setToken } from \"./api\";\nimport Layout from \"./components/Layout\";\nimport AccountsPage from \"./pages/AccountsPage\";\nimport LoginPage from \"./pages/LoginPage\";\nimport SalesInvoicesPage from \"./pages/SalesInvoicesPage\";\nimport TrialBalancePage from \"./pages/TrialBalancePage\";\nimport type { User } from \"./types\";\n\nconst USER_KEY = \"bop-erp.user\";\n\nfunction loadUser(): User | null {\n  const raw = localStorage.getItem(USER_KEY);\n  if (!raw || !getToken()) return null;\n  try {\n    return JSON.parse(raw) as User;\n  } catch {\n    return null;\n  }\n}\n\nexport type Page = \"sales\" | \"accounts\" | \"reports\";\n\nexport default function App() {\n  const [user, setUser] = useState<User | null>(loadUser);\n  const [page, setPage] = useState<Page>(\"sales\");\n\n  if (!user) {\n    return (\n      <LoginPage\n        onLogin={(loggedIn, token) => {\n          setToken(token);\n          localStorage.setItem(USER_KEY, JSON.stringify(loggedIn));\n          setUser(loggedIn);\n        }}\n      />\n    );\n  }\n\n  return (\n    <Layout\n      user={user}\n      page={page}\n      onNavigate={setPage}\n      onLogout={() => {\n        setToken(null);\n        localStorage.removeItem(USER_KEY);\n        setUser(null);\n      }}\n    >\n      {page === \"sales\" && <SalesInvoicesPage />}\n      {page === \"accounts\" && <AccountsPage />}\n      {page === \"reports\" && <TrialBalancePage />}\n    </Layout>\n  );\n}\n"
}

err.message : \"Login failed.\");\n    } finally {\n      setBusy(false);\n    }\n  }\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"login-wrap\">\n      <form className=\"login-card\" onSubmit={submit}>\n        <h1>BOP Nutraceuticals</h1>\n        <div className=\"sub\">Sign in to the ERP</div>\n        {error && <div className=\"error\">{error}</div>}\n        <div className=\"grid\" style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>\n          <div>\n            <label htmlFor=\"username\">Username</label>\n            <input\n              id=\"username\"\n              value={username}\n              onChange={(e) => setUsername(e.target.value)}\n              autoComplete=\"username\"\n              style={{ width: \"100%\" }}\n            />\n          </div>\n          <div>\n            <label htmlFor=\"password\">Password</label>\n            <input\n              id=\"password\"\n              type=\"password\"\n              value={password}\n              onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}\n              autoComplete=\"current-password\"\n              style={{ width: \"100%\" }}\n            />\n          </div>\n          <button className=\"primary\" type=\"submit\" disabled={busy}>\n            {busy ? \"Signing in...\" : \"Sign in\"}\n          </button>\n        </div>\n        <p className=\"sub\" style={{ marginTop: 14 }}>\n          Default local account: admin / admin123\n        </p>\n      </form>\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n"
}

It talks to\nthe **existing SQLite Cloud database** — the schema, the seeded chart of\naccounts and doc formats (e.g. `SI-00002`) are reused unchanged, and the\npassword hashes stay compatible.\n\n## Why the rewrite\n\nThe original is a business/accounting system written in Python with a Qt\ndesktop GUI, storing money in `REAL` (floating point) columns. An ERP needs\nexact money arithmetic, strong typing, real multi-user access and reliable\ntransactions. TypeScript provides typed contracts end-to-end, and this rewrite\nperforms all money arithmetic in exact decimal (`decimal.js`), converting to a\nnumber only at the database boundary.\n\n## Layout\n\n```\nweb/\n├── server/                 Node + Express + TypeScript API and business logic\n│   ├── src/\n│   │   ├── domain/         Enums, errors, exact-decimal money helpers\n│   │   ├── db/             SqlDatabase abstraction, schema, bootstrap, adapters\n│   │   │   ├── localSqlite.ts     development / tests (node:sqlite, no network)\n│   │   │   └── sqliteCloud.ts     the hosted SQLite Cloud database\n│   │   ├── repositories/   data access (accounts, journal, sales, stock, ...)\n│   │   ├── services/       accounting engine, sales, auth, reports\n│   │   ├── http/           Express app and routes\n│   │   ├── index.ts        server entry point\n│   │   ├── seed.ts         seed local demo data\n│   │   └── smoke.ts        end-to-end HTTP smoke test\n│   └── tests/              vitest unit + integration tests\n└── client/                 React + Vite web client\n    └── src/pages/          login, sales invoices, chart of accounts, reports\n```\n\nLayering mirrors the original: `views (React) → http → services → repositories → db`.\n\n## Getting started\n\n```bash\ncd web\nnpm install\n\n# development (API on :4000, client on :5173 with /api proxied to the server)\nnpm run dev\n\n# or individually\nnpm run dev:server\nnpm run dev:client\n```\n\nConfiguration lives in `web/.env` (git-ignored). Copy `.env.example` to start.\nBy default the server uses a **local SQLite file** (`web/data/dev.sqlite`) so\ndevelopment never touches production data. To point at the hosted database:\n\n```\nERP_DB_ENGINE=sqlitecloud\nSQLITE_CLOUD_URL=sqlitecloud://user:password@host:port/database\n```\n\nThe hosted database is **never** bootstrapped (no DDL/seed) — only the local\ndatabase is created and seeded automatically.\n\n## Verification\n\n```bash\nnpm run typecheck   # tsc for server and client\nnpm test            # vitest (money, accounting engine, sales invoice)\nnpm run smoke       # boots the API against a throwaway DB and drives it over HTTP\nnpm run build       # production build of the client\n```\n\n## Money handling\n\n`server/src/domain/money.ts` is the only place money is arithmetic'd:\n`round2`, `sum`, `toStorage`. Values are stored to 2 decimal places half-up,\nmatching the original rounding but without IEEE-754 drift.\n\n## Compatibility with the Python app\n\n- **Schema**: `server/src/db/schema.ts` is ported verbatim from `database/schema.py`.\n- **Password hashing**: PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256, 200k iterations, 16-byte salt, hex\n  encoded — existing users log in unchanged.\n- **Voucher numbering**: same `numbering_sequences` upsert-with-`RETURNING`, so\n  numbers continue from the existing sequence.\n- **System accounts**: resolved by code (`1000`, `1100`, `4000`, ...), never by id.\n\n## Implemented in this slice\n\nAccounting core (double-entry engine, trial balance, P&L) and the **sales\ninvoice** module end-to-end: validation, exact totals, FIFO stock consumption,\nrevenue / tax / COGS journal posting, REST API and React UI.\n\n## Remaining modules (next passes)\n\nPurchase invoices, payments/receipts, manufacturing (BOM + production orders),\nexpenses, banking/cheques, assets, sales/purchase returns, users & permissions,\nsettings, audit log, backups, and the remaining financial reports (balance\nsheet, party ledger, cash book) plus PDF/Excel export.\n"
}

## What I did

I read the whole project (~48k lines, 180 Python files) and rebuilt it as a **TypeScript full-stack web app** (`web/`) talking to the existing **SQLite Cloud** database. I started with the agreed vertical slice: **accounting core + sales, end-to-end**.

**Key finding:** the Python app stores money as `REAL` floats and rounds manually — the main correctness risk for an ERP. The rewrite does all arithmetic in exact decimal (`decimal.js`), converting to a number only at the DB boundary.

### Implemented and verified

**Server** (`web/server`, Express + TS):
- `db/` — a `SqlDatabase` abstraction with two adapters: `localSqlite.ts` (node:sqlite, for dev/tests) and `sqliteCloud.ts` (the hosted DB, with a re-entrant async transaction lock).
- `db/schema.ts` — the schema ported **verbatim** from `database/schema.py`.
- `domain/money.ts` — exact-decimal money helpers.
- `repositories/` — accounts, journal, parties, items, stock batches, sales, users.
- `services/` — `AccountingService` (double-entry engine, gap-free voucher numbering, trial balance), `SalesInvoiceService` (validation, totals, FIFO stock, revenue/tax/COGS posting), `AuthService` (**PBKDF2 identical to Python**, so existing users log in), `ReportService` (trial balance + P&L).
- `http/app.ts` — REST API; `smoke.ts` — HTTP end-to-end test.

**Client** (`web/client`, React + Vite): login, sales invoice list + create form, chart of accounts, trial balance & P&L, dark theme.

### Verification (all green)
- `npm run typecheck` (server + client) → exit 0
- `npm test` → **15/15 tests passed** (money exactness, accounting balance/voucher rules, sales invoice + stock + journal + conflict + insufficient-stock)
- `npm run smoke` → **all HTTP checks passed** (login → create invoice `SI-00002`, total 750; journal lines balance 1250/1250; P&L revenue 750 / COGS 500 / net 250), and it is idempotent across runs.
- Client `vite build` succeeds; **dev integration verified** by running both services and curling through the Vite proxy (`/api/health` → ok; login through the proxy returns a token).
- I found and fixed a real bug during testing: credit-normal accounts were landing in the trial-balance debit column.

### Limitations (not yet verified / not done)
- **Only the vertical slice is built.** Purchases, payments, manufacturing, expenses, banking, assets, returns, users/permissions, settings, backups and the remaining reports (balance sheet, ledger, cash book) are still to be rebuilt — listed in `web/README.md`.
- The live **SQLite Cloud adapter typechecks but was deliberately not exercised against production** (I avoided writing to the real hosted DB; local runs use `web/data/dev.sqlite`, and `smoke` uses a throwaway DB).
- Client↔server was verified via proxy + `curl`, not a real browser (Chrome isn't installed here), so there's no DOM-level UI test.
- Money remains `REAL` in the existing DB (required by "keep SQLite Cloud"); exactness is enforced in code before storage.

Nothing was committed — all changes are new files under `web/`.

> _Reasoning_
> I'm mid-way through implementing purchases (haven't finished it), so no todo update needed yet. Let me continue: I now understand the purchase JE:
> 
> - Debit inventory accounts split by item type: RAW_MATERIAL→1200, PACKING_MATERIAL→1210, FINISHED_GOOD→1220 (amount = line_total per type).
> - Credit sales tax payable (2100) for tax_amount (input tax).
> - Credit amount = total_amount - tax_amount:
>   - CREDIT → Accounts Payable (2000), party_id = supplier_id.
>   - CASH → Cash (1000).
>   - BANK/CHEQUE with bank_account_id → bank_accounts.account_id.
>   - BANK/CHEQUE without → Bank (1010).
> - Then within transaction: get_or_create batch, insert invoice item with batch_id, update stock quantity (+quantity), post JE.
> - Bank transaction WITHDRAWAL if BANK/CHEQUE with bank_account_id.
>

{
  "path": "web/server/src/repositories/purchaseRepository.ts",
  "instructions": "Data access for purchase invoices and their line items",
  "content": "import type { Row, SqlDatabase } from \"../db/types.js\";\nimport type { DocumentStatus, PaymentMethod } from \"../domain/enums.js\";\nimport { insertRow, type InsertData } from \"./base.js\";\n\nexport interface PurchaseInvoiceRow {\n  id: number;\n  company_id: number;\n  warehouse_id: number;\n  invoice_number: string;\n  supplier_id: number;\n  invoice_date: string;\n  payment_type: PaymentMethod;\n  bank_account_id: number | null;\n  subtotal: number;\n  discount_amount: number;\n  tax_amount: number;\n  total_amount: number;\n  paid_amount: number;\n  status: DocumentStatus;\n  notes: string | null;\n  created_by: number | null;\n  created_at: string;\n  updated_at: string | null;\n}\n\nexport interface PurchaseInvoiceListRow extends PurchaseInvoiceRow {\n  supplier_name: string;\n  supplier_code: string;\n}\n\nexport class PurchaseRepository {\n  constructor(private readonly db: SqlDatabase) {}\n\n  async invoiceNumberExists(invoiceNumber: string, companyId = 1): Promise<boolean> {\n    const row = await this.db.get<{ id: number }>(\n      \"SELECT id FROM purchase_invoices WHERE company_id = ? AND invoice_number = ?\",\n      [companyId, invoiceNumber],\n    );\n    return row !== undefined;\n  }\n\n  async insertInvoice(data: InsertData): Promise<number> {\n    return insertRow(this.db, \"purchase_invoices\", data);\n  }\n\n  async insertItem(data: InsertData): Promise<number> {\n    return insertRow(this.db, \"purchase_invoice_items\", data);\n  }\n\n  async findById(id: number): Promise<PurchaseInvoiceRow | undefined> {\n    return this.db.get<PurchaseInvoiceRow>(\"SELECT * FROM purchase_invoices WHERE id = ?\", [id]);\n  }\n\n  async findItems(invoiceId: number): Promise<Row[]> {\n    return this.db.all<Row>(\n      `SELECT pii.*, i.item_code, i.item_name, i.unit\n       FROM purchase_invoice_items pii\n       JOIN items i ON i.id = pii.item_id\n       WHERE pii.invoice_id = ?\n       ORDER BY pii.id`,\n      [invoiceId],\n    );\n  }\n\n  async list(\n    companyId = 1,\n    opts: { limit?: number; offset?: number; search?: string } = {},\n  ): Promise<PurchaseInvoiceListRow[]> {\n    let sql = `\n      SELECT pi.*, p.name AS supplier_name, p.code AS supplier_code\n      FROM purchase_invoices pi\n      JOIN parties p ON p.id = pi.supplier_id\n      WHERE pi.company_id = ?`;\n    const params: Array<string | number> = [companyId];\n    if (opts.search) {\n      sql += \" AND (pi.invoice_number LIKE ? OR p.name LIKE ?)\";\n      const like = `%${opts.search}%`;\n      params.push(like, like);\n    }\n    sql += \" ORDER BY pi.invoice_date DESC, pi.id DESC LIMIT ? OFFSET ?\";\n    params.push(opts.limit ?? 100, opts.offset ?? 0);\n    return this.db.all<PurchaseInvoiceListRow>(sql, params);\n  }\n}\n"
}

    typeTotals.set(\n        line.item.item_type,\n        (typeTotals.get(line.item.item_type) ?? new Decimal(0)).plus(line.lineTotal),\n      );\n    }\n\n    let invoiceNumber = input.invoiceNumber?.trim() || \"\";\n    if (invoiceNumber) {\n      if (await this.purchases.invoiceNumberExists(invoiceNumber, companyId)) {\n        throw new ConflictError(`Invoice number toStorage(line.lineTotal),\n        });\n      }\n\n      const journalEntryId = await this.accounting.postJournalEntry({\n        voucherType: \"PURCHASE\",\n        entryDate: input.invoiceDate,\n   };\n    });\n  }\n\n  private async resolvePaymentAccount(\n    input: CreatePurchaseInvoiceInput,\n    resolver: SystemAccountResolver,\n    supplierId: number,\n  ): Promise<{ accountId: number;       """Payment service - record payments to suppliers and receipts from customers."""
      from __future__ import annotations
      
      from datetime import datetime
      from decimal import Decimal
      
      from database.connection import DatabaseConnection, get_db
      from models.enums import VoucherType
      from services.accounting_service import AccountingService, JournalLine
      from repositories.party_repository import PartyRepository
      from repositories.account_repository import AccountRepository
      from utils.exceptions import ValidationError
      from utils.logger import get_logger
      from utils.activity_logger import log_payment_created
      
      logger = get_logger(__name__)
      
      
      # Global dashboard service instance for cache invalidation
      _dashboard_service_instance = None
      
      
      def get_dashboard_service():
          """Get or create the global dashboard service instance."""
          global _dashboard_service_instance
          if _dashboard_service_instance is None:
              from services.dashboard_service import DashboardService
              _dashboard_service_instance = DashboardService()
          return _dashboard_service_instance
      
      
      class PaymentService:
          """Service for recording payments to suppliers and receipts from customers."""
      
          def __init__(self, db: DatabaseConnection | None = None):
              self.db = db or get_db()
              self.party_repo = PartyRepository(self.db)
              self.account_repo = AccountRepository(self.db)
              self.accounting_service = AccountingService(self.db)
          
          def pay_supplier(
              self,
              supplier_id: int,
              amount: float,
              payment_date: str,
              payment_method: str = "BANK",
              reference_no: str | None = None,
              notes: str | None = None,
              purchase_invoice_id: int | None = None,
          ) -> int:
              """
              Record a payment to a supplier.
              """
              # Validate supplier
              supplier = self.party_repo.get_by_id(supplier_id)
              if not supplier:
                  raise ValidationError("Supplier does not exist.")
              
              if supplier["party_type"] not in ["SUPPLIER", "BOTH"]:
                  raise ValidationError(
                      f"Cannot pay {supplier['name']} ({supplier['party_type']}). "
                      "Only suppliers can be paid."
                  )
              
              if amount <= 0:
                  raise ValidationError("Amount must be greater than 0.")
              
              # Get accounts
              ap_account = self.account_repo.find_by_code("2000")
              if not ap_account:
                  raise ValidationError("Accounts Payable account (2000) not found.")
      
              # Get payment account
              if payment_method == "CASH":
                  payment_account = self.account_repo.find_by_code("1000")
                  if not payment_account:
                      raise ValidationError("Cash account (1000) not found.")
              elif payment_method in ["BANK", "CHEQUE"]:
                  payment_account = self.account_repo.find_by_code("1010")
                  if not payment_account:
                      raise ValidationError("Bank account (1010) not found.")
              else:
                  raise ValidationError("Invalid payment method.")
              
              # Prepare journal entry
              journal_lines = [
                  JournalLine(
                      account_id=ap_account["id"],
                      debit=amount,
                      credit=0,
                      party_id=supplier_id,  # ✅ ADD THIS - links payment to supplier
                      description=f"Payment to {supplier['name']}"
                  ),
                  JournalLine(
                      account_id=payment_account["id"],
                      debit=0,
                      credit=amount,
                      description=f"Payment to {supplier['name']}"
                  )
              ]
              
              # Post journal entry
              with self.db.transaction():
                  # Generate voucher number
                  voucher_number = self.accounting_service.journal_repo.next_voucher_number(
                      1, VoucherType.PAYMENT.value
                  )
                  
                  self.accounting_service.post_journal_entry(
                      voucher_type=VoucherType.PAYMENT,
                      entry_date=payment_date,
                      lines=journal_lines,
                      source_table="payments",
                      source_id=None,
                      voucher_number=voucher_number,
                      narration=f"Payment to {supplier['name']} - {reference_no or ''}"
                  )
                  
                  # Save payment record
                  self.db.execute("""
                      INSERT INTO payments (
                          company_id, voucher_number, party_id, payment_date,
                          payment_method, amount, notes, created_at
                      ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, datetime('now'))
                  """, (1, voucher_number, supplier_id, payment_date, payment_method, amount, notes))
                  
                  payment_id = self.db.last_insert_id()
                  
                  # Update purchase invoice paid amount if provided
                  if purchase_invoice_id:
                      self.db.execute("""
                          UPDATE purchase_invoices 
                          SET paid_amount = paid_amount + ? 
                          WHERE id = ?
                      """, (amount, purchase_invoice_id))
                      logger.info(f"✅ Updated paid_amount for purchase invoice {purchase_invoice_id}: +{amount}")
                  
                  # Invalidate dashboard cache to force refresh on next view
                  try:
                      dashboard_service = get_dashboard_service()
                      dashboard_service.invalidate_cache()
                      logger.info("✅ Dashboard cache invalidated after payment")
                  except Exception as e:
                      logger.warning(f"Could not invalidate dashboard cache: {e}")
                  
                  logger.info(f"Payment {voucher_number} recorded: Rs. {amount:,.2f} to {supplier['name']}")
                  
                  # Log activity
                  log_payment_created(
                      payment_id=payment_id,
                      payment_type="PAYMENT",
                      amount=amount,
                      party_name=supplier['name'],
                  )
                  
                  return payment_id

{\n        await this.payments.addSalesInvoicePaid(input.salesInvoiceId, toStorage(amount));\n      }\n\n      return { id, voucherNumber, journalEntryId };\n    });\n  }\n\n  private async settlementAccount(\n    resolver: SystemAccountResolver,\n    method: SettlementMethod,\n  ): Promise<number> {\n    if (method === \"CASH\") return resolver.idFor(SystemAccountCodes.CASH_IN_HAND);\n err.message : \"Failed to load payments.\");\n    }\n  }\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    void refresh();\n    void api.parties(\"SUPPLIER\").then(setSuppliers).catch(() => undefined);\n    void api.parties(\"CUSTOMER\").then(setCustomers).catch(() => undefined);\n  }, []);\n\n  async function submit(event: FormEvent) {\n    event.preventDefault();\n    setError(null);\n    setNotice(null);\n    if (!partyId) {\n      setError(tab === \"payments\" ?           def create_bom(
              self,
              finished_item_id: int,           # ← Required
              output_quantity: float,          # ← Required
              components: list[dict],          # ← Required
              bom_name: str | None = None,     # ← Optional (auto-generate)
              notes: str | None = None,
              company_id: int = 1,
          ) -> BillOfMaterials:
              """
              Create a new Bill of Materials with AUTO-GENERATED name if not provided.
              """
              # 1. Validate finished item
              finished_item = self.item_repo.get_by_id(finished_item_id)
              if not finished_item:
                  raise ValidationError("Finished item does not exist.")
              if finished_item["item_type"] != "FINISHED_GOOD":
                  raise ValidationError("Finished item must be of type FINISHED_GOOD.")
      
              # 2. ✅ Handle BOM name (manual validation only; auto-generate inside transaction)
              if bom_name is not None:
                  bom_name = bom_name.strip()
                  if not bom_name:
                      raise ValidationError("BOM name cannot be empty.")
                  existing = self.bom_repo.find_by_name(bom_name, company_id)
                  if existing:
                      raise ValidationError(f"BOM name '{bom_name}' already exists.")
              # (auto-generate happens inside the transaction below)
      
              if output_quantity <= 0:
                  raise ValidationError("Output quantity must be greater than 0.")
              if not components:
                  raise ValidationError("At least one component is required.")
      
              # 3. Validate components
              validated_components = []
              for comp in components:
                  component_item_id = comp.get("component_item_id")
                  quantity_required = comp.get("quantity_required", 0)
                  wastage_percent = comp.get("wastage_percent", 0)
      
                  if not component_item_id or quantity_required <= 0:
                      raise ValidationError("Each component requires an item and quantity.")

          def complete_production(
              self,
              order_id: int,
              actual_quantity: float,
              wastage_quantity: float = 0,
              output_batch_number: str | None = None,
          ) -> None:
              """
              Complete a production order.
              This creates accounting entries and updates stock.
              """
              order = self.get_production_order(order_id)
              if not order:
                  raise ValidationError("Production order not found.")
              if order.status != "IN_PROGRESS":
                  raise ValidationError(f"Cannot complete order with status '{order.status}'.")
      
              if actual_quantity <= 0:
                  raise ValidationError("Actual quantity must be greater than 0.")
              if wastage_quantity < 0:
                  raise ValidationError("Wastage quantity cannot be negative.")
      
              # Get BOM and components
              bom = self.get_bom(order.bom_id)
              if not bom:
                  raise ValidationError("BOM not found.")
      
              # Calculate required raw materials
              ratio = actual_quantity / bom.output_quantity
              required_materials = []
              total_raw_cost = Decimal('0')
              total_packing_cost = Decimal('0')
      
              for component in bom.components:
                  required_qty = component.quantity_required * ratio
                  wastage_qty = required_qty * (component.wastage_percent / 100)
                  total_required = required_qty + wastage_qty
      
                  # Get current stock
                  stock_batch = self.stock_repo.find_by_item_and_warehouse(
                      component.component_item_id,
                      order.warehouse_id
                  )
      
                  if not stock_batch:
                      item = self.item_repo.get_by_id(component.component_item_id)
                      raise InsufficientStockError(
                          f"No stock batch found for {item['item_name']}. "
                          f"Required: {total_required:.2f}"
                      )
      
                  if stock_batch["quantity_in_stock"] < total_required:
                      item = self.item_repo.get_by_id(component.component_item_id)
                      raise InsufficientStockError(
                          f"Insufficient stock for {item['item_name']}. "
                          f"Required: {total_required:.2f}, Available: {stock_batch['quantity_in_stock']:.2f}"
                      )
      
                  unit_cost = stock_batch["purchase_price"] if stock_batch else 0
      
                  component_item = self.item_repo.get_by_id(component.component_item_id)
                  is_packing = component_item["item_type"] == "PACKING_MATERIAL"
      
                  required_materials.append({
                      "component_item_id": component.component_item_id,
                      "batch_id": stock_batch["id"] if stock_batch else None,
                      "quantity_consumed": float(total_required),
                      "unit_cost": unit_cost,
                      "total_cost": float(total_required) * unit_cost,
                      "is_packing": is_packing,
                  })
      
                  material_cost = Decimal(str(float(total_required) * unit_cost))
                  if is_packing:
                      total_packing_cost += material_cost
                  else:
                      total_raw_cost += material_cost
      
              total_cost = total_raw_cost + total_packing_cost
      
              # Get accounts for journal entry
              inventory_raw_account = self.account_repo.find_by_code("1200")
              if not inventory_raw_account:
                  raise ValidationError("Inventory Raw Materials account (1200) not found.")
      
              inventory_packing_account = self.account_repo.find_by_code("1210")
              if not inventory_packing_account:
                  raise ValidationError("Inventory Packing Materials account (1210) not found.")
      
              inventory_finished_account = self.account_repo.find_by_code("1220")
              if not inventory_finished_account:
                  raise ValidationError("Inventory Finished Goods account (1220) not found.")
      
              wastage_account = self.account_repo.find_by_code("5200")
              if not wastage_account:
                  raise ValidationError("Manufacturing Wastage account (5200) not found.")
      
              # Prepare journal entry lines
              journal_lines = [
                  JournalLine(
                      account_id=inventory_finished_account["id"],
                      debit=float(total_cost),
                      credit=0.0,
                      description=f"Production output - {order.order_number}"
                  ),
              ]
      
              if total_raw_cost > 0:
                  journal_lines.append(JournalLine(
                      account_id=inventory_raw_account["id"],
                      debit=0.0,
                      credit=float(total_raw_cost),
                      description=f"Raw materials consumed - {order.order_number}"
                  ))
              if total_packing_cost > 0:
                  journal_lines.append(JournalLine(
                      account_id=inventory_packing_account["id"],
                      debit=0.0,
                      credit=float(total_packing_cost),
                      description=f"Packing materials consumed - {order.order_number}"
                  ))
      
              # Save everything in a single transaction
              with self.db.transaction():
                  # Update production order
                  self.order_repo.update_with_timestamp(
                      order_id,
                      {
                          "actual_quantity": actual_quantity,
                          "wastage_quantity": wastage_quantity,
                          "output_batch_number": output_batch_number,
                          "production_cost": float(total_cost),
                          "raw_material_cost": float(total_raw_cost),
                          "packing_material_cost": float(total_packing_cost),
                          "status": "COMPLETED",
                          "completed_at": datetime.now().isoformat(),
                      }
                  )
      
                  # Create consumption records
                  for material in required_materials:
                      consumption = ProductionConsumption(
                          production_order_id=order_id,
                          component_item_id=material["component_item_id"],
                          batch_id=material["batch_id"],
                          quantity_consumed=material["quantity_consumed"],
                          unit_cost=material["unit_cost"],
                      )
                      self.consumption_repo.insert(consumption.to_dict())
      
                      # Update stock quantity
                      self.stock_repo.update_quantity(
                          material["batch_id"],
                          -material["quantity_consumed"]
                      )
      
                  # Create or update finished goods stock
                  if output_batch_number:
                      existing_batch = self.stock_repo.find_by_item_and_warehouse(
                          bom.finished_item_id,
                          order.warehouse_id
                      )
      
                      raw_unit_cost = float(total_raw_cost) / actual_quantity if actual_quantity > 0 else 0
                      packing_unit_cost = float(total_packing_cost) / actual_quantity if actual_quantity > 0 else 0
      
                      if existing_batch:
                          new_qty = existing_batch["quantity_in_stock"] + actual_quantity
                          self.stock_repo.add_to_batch(
                              existing_batch["id"],
                              actual_quantity,
                              unit_cost=float(total_cost) / actual_quantity,
                              raw_unit_cost=raw_unit_cost,
                              packing_unit_cost=packing_unit_cost,
                          )
                          logger.info(f"Updated existing batch for finished item: +{actual_quantity} (now {new_qty})")
                      else:
                          self.stock_repo.create_batch(
                              item_id=bom.finished_item_id,
                              warehouse_id=order.warehouse_id,
                              batch_number=output_batch_number,
                              manufacturing_date=order.manufacturing_date,
                              expiry_date=order.expiry_date,
                              purchase_price=float(total_cost) / actual_quantity,
                              quantity_in_stock=actual_quantity,
                              raw_unit_cost=raw_unit_cost,
                              packing_unit_cost=packing_unit_cost,
                          )
                          logger.info(f"Created new batch for finished item: {actual_quantity}")
      
                  # Post journal entry
                  self.accounting_service.post_journal_entry(
                      voucher_type=VoucherType.MANUFACTURING,
                      entry_date=datetime.now().isoformat(),
                      lines=journal_lines,
                      source_table="production_orders",
                      source_id=order_id,
                      narration=f"Production order {order.order_number} completed"
                  )
      
              logger.info("Completed production order %s (id=%s), cost=%.2f (raw=%.2f, packing=%.2f)",
                         order.order_number, order_id, total_cost, total_raw_cost, total_packing_cost)

ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 200\",\n      [companyId],\n    );\n  }\n\n  async updateOrder(id: number, data: InsertData): Promise<void> {\n    const cols = Object.keys(data);\n    if (cols.length === 0) return;\n    const assignments = cols.map((c) => `${c} = ?`).join(\", \");\n    await this.db.run(`UPDATE production_orders SET ${assignments} WHERE id = ?`, [\n      ...cols.map((c) => data[c] ?? null),\n      id,\n    ]);\n  }\n\n  async insertConsumption(data: InsertData): Promise<number> {\n    return insertRow(this.db, \"production_consumption\", data);\n  }\n\n  async findConsumptions(orderId: number): Promise<Row[]> {\n    return this.db.all<Row>(\n      \"SELECT * FROM production_consumption WHERE production_order_id = ? ORDER BY id\",\n      [orderId],\n    );\n  }\n}\n"

      import { useState } from "react";
      import { getToken, setToken } from "./api";
      import Layout from "./components/Layout";
      import AccountsPage from "./pages/AccountsPage";
      import LoginPage from "./pages/LoginPage";
      import ManufacturingPage from "./pages/ManufacturingPage";
      import PaymentsPage from "./pages/PaymentsPage";
      import PurchaseInvoicesPage from "./pages/PurchaseInvoicesPage";
      import SalesInvoicesPage from "./pages/SalesInvoicesPage";
      import TrialBalancePage from "./pages/TrialBalancePage";
      import type { User } from "./types";
      
      const USER_KEY = "bop-erp.user";
      
      function loadUser(): User | null {
        const raw = localStorage.getItem(USER_KEY);
        if (!raw || !getToken()) return null;
        try {
          return JSON.parse(raw) as User;
        } catch {
          return null;
        }
      }
      
      export type Page = "sales" | "purchases" | "payments" | "manufacturing" | "accounts" | "reports";
      
      export default function App() {
        const [user, setUser] = useState<User | null>(loadUser);
        const [page, setPage] = useState<Page>("sales");
      
        if (!user) {
          return (
            <LoginPage
              onLogin={(loggedIn, token) => {
                setToken(token);
                localStorage.setItem(USER_KEY, JSON.stringify(loggedIn));
                setUser(loggedIn);
              }}
            />
          );
        }
      
        return (
          <Layout
            user={user}
            page={page}
            onNavigate={setPage}
            onLogout={() => {
              setToken(null);
              localStorage.removeItem(USER_KEY);
              setUser(null);
            }}
          >
            {page === "sales" && <SalesInvoicesPage />}
            {page === "purchases" && <PurchaseInvoicesPage />}
            {page === "payments" && <PaymentsPage />}
            {page === "manufacturing" && <ManufacturingPage />}
            {page === "accounts" && <AccountsPage />}
            {page === "reports" && <TrialBalancePage />}
          </Layout>
        );
      }
      
  referencedBy: {}

          def create_expense(
              self,
              voucher_number: str,
              category_id: int,
              expense_date: str,
              amount: float,
              payment_method: str,
              bank_account_id: int | None = None,
              cheque_id: int | None = None,
              description: str | None = None,
              company_id: int = 1,
              created_by: int | None = None,
          ) -> Expense:
              """Create an expense with automatic journal entry."""
              # Validate inputs
              voucher_number = voucher_number.strip()
              if not voucher_number:
                  raise ValidationError("Voucher number is required.")
              if amount <= 0:
                  raise ValidationError("Amount must be greater than 0.")
              if payment_method not in ["CASH", "BANK", "CHEQUE"]:
                  raise ValidationError("Invalid payment method.")
              expense_date = parse_date(expense_date, "expense_date")
      
              # Validate category
              category = self.get_category(category_id)
              if not category.is_active:
                  raise ValidationError("Category is not active.")
      
              # Get expense account
              expense_account_id = category.account_id
              if not expense_account_id:
                  # If no account linked, try to find/default expense account
                  account = self.account_repo.find_by_code("6000")  # General & Admin Expenses
                  if account:
                      expense_account_id = account["id"]
                  else:
                      # Create a default expense account
                      from services.account_service import AccountService
                      from models.enums import AccountType
                      account_service = AccountService(self.db)
                      new_account = account_service.create_account(
                          account_code=f"EXP-{category.id:03d}",
                          account_name=f"Expense: {category.name}",
                          account_type=AccountType.EXPENSE,
                          parent_account_id=None,
                          opening_balance=0,
                      )
                      expense_account_id = new_account.id
      
              # Get payment account - FIXED: Use Cash or default bank account
              if payment_method == "CASH":
                  cash_account = self.account_repo.find_by_code("1000")
                  if not cash_account:
                      raise ValidationError("Cash account (1000) not found.")
                  payment_account_id = cash_account["id"]
              else:
                  # For BANK or CHEQUE, use Bank Accounts (1010)
                  bank_account = self.account_repo.find_by_code("1010")
                  if not bank_account:
                      raise ValidationError("Bank account (1010) not found.")
                  payment_account_id = bank_account["id"]
      
              # Prepare journal entry
              journal_lines = [
                  JournalLine(
                      account_id=expense_account_id,
                      debit=amount,
                      credit=0,

  "instructions": "Data access for expense categories and expense vouchers",
  "content": "import type { SqlDatabase } from \"../db/types.js\";\nimport type { PaymentMethod } from \"../domain/enums.js\";\nimport { insertRow, type InsertData } from \"./base.js\";\n\nexport interface ExpenseCategoryRow {\n  id: number;\n  company_id: number;\n  name: string;\n  account_id: number | null;\n  is_active: number;\n  created_at: string;\n}\n\nexport interface ExpenseRow {\n  id: number;\n  company_id: number;\n  voucher_number: string;\n  category_id: number;\n  expense_date: string;\n  amount: number;\n  payment_method: PaymentMethod;\n  bank_account_id: number | null;\n  cheque_id: number | null;\n  description: string | null;\n  created_by: number | null;\n  created_at: string;\n}\n\nexport interface ExpenseListRow extends ExpenseRow {\n  category_name: string;\n}\n\nexport class ExpenseRepository {\n  constructor(private readonly db: SqlDatabase) {}\n\n  async insertCategory(data: InsertData): Promise<number> {\n    return insertRow(this.db, \"expense_categories\", data);\n  }\n\n  async findCategoryById(id: number): Promise<ExpenseCategoryRow | undefined> {\n    return this.db.get<ExpenseCategoryRow>(\"SELECT * FROM expense_categories WHERE id = ?\", [id]);\n  }\n\n  async categoryNameExists(name: string, companyId = 1): Promise<boolean> {\n    const row = await this.db.get<{ id: number }>(\n      \"SELECT id FROM expense_categories WHERE name = ? AND company_id = ?\",\n      [name, companyId],\n    );\n    return row !== undefined;\n  }\n\n  async listCategories(companyId = 1, activeOnly = true): Promise<ExpenseCategoryRow[]> {\n    return this.db.all<ExpenseCategoryRow>(\n      \"SELECT * FROM expense_categories WHERE company_id = ?\" +\n        (activeOnly ? \" AND is_active = 1\" : \"\") +\n        \" ORDER BY name\",\n      [companyId],\n    );\n  }\n\n  async insertExpense(data: InsertData): Promise<number> {\n    return insertRow(this.db, \"expenses\", data);\n  }\n\n  async voucherExists(voucherNumber: string, companyId = 1): Promise<boolean> {\n    const row = await this.db.get<{ id: number }>(\n      \"SELECT id FROM expenses WHERE company_id = ? AND voucher_number = ?\",\n      [companyId, voucherNumber],\n    );\n    return row !== undefined;\n  }\n\n  async findExpenseById(id: number): Promise<ExpenseRow | undefined> {\n    return this.db.get<ExpenseRow>(\"SELECT * FROM expenses WHERE id = ?\", [id]);\n  }\n\n  async listExpenses(companyId = 1, limit = 200): Promise<ExpenseListRow[]> {\n    return this.db.all<ExpenseListRow>(\n      `SELECT e.*, c.name AS category_name\n       FROM expenses e JOIN expense_categories c ON c.id = e.category_id\n       WHERE e.company_id = ?\n       ORDER BY e.expense_date DESC, e.id DESC LIMIT ?`,\n      [companyId, limit],\n    );\n  }\n}\n"
}

} from \"../db/types.js\";\nimport { SystemAccountCodes } from \"../domain/enums.js\";\nimport { ConflictError, NotFoundError, ValidationError } from \"../domain/errors.js\";\nimport { dec, round2, ExpenseListRow,\n} from \"../repositories/expenseRepository.js\";\nimport { JournalRepository } from \"../repositories/journalRepository.js\";\nimport { SystemAccountResolver } from \"../repositories/systemAccounts.js\";\nimport { AccountingService } from \"./accountingService.js\";\n\nexport type ExpensePaymentMethod = \"CASH\" | \"BANK\" | \"CHEQUE\";\n\nexport interface CreateExpenseInput {\n  categoryId: number;\n  expenseDate: string;\n  amount: number | string;\n  paymentMethod: ExpensePaymentMethod;\n  voucherNumber?: string | null;\n  bankAccountId?: number | null;\n  chequeId?: number | null;\n  description?: string | null;\n  companyId?: number;\n  createdBy?: number | null;\n}\n\nexport interface ExpenseResult {\n  id: number;\n  voucherNumber: JournalRepository;\n  private readonly accounting: AccountingService;\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly db: SqlDatabase,\n    private readonly companyId = 1,\n  ) {\n    this.accounts = new AccountRepository(db);\n    this.expenses = new ExpenseRepository(db);\n    this.journal = new JournalRepository(db);\n    this.accounting = new AccountingService(db, companyId);\n  }\n\n  async listCategories(): Promise<ExpenseCategoryRow[]> {\n    return this.expenses.listCategories(this.companyId);\n  }\n\n  async createCategory(\n    name: string,\n    accountId?: number | null,\n  ): Promise<{ id: number; name: string }> {\n    const clean = name.trim();\n    if (!clean) throw new ValidationError(\"Category name is required.\");\n    if (await this.expenses.categoryNameExists(clean, this.companyId)) {\n      throw new ConflictError(`Category '${clean}' already exists.`);\n    }\n    if (accountId) {\n      const account = await this.accounts.findById(accountId);\n      if (!account) throw new NotFoundError(`Account ${accountId} not found.`);\n      if (account.account_type !== \"EXPENSE\") {\n        throw new ValidationError(\"Account must be of type EXPENSE.\");\n      }\n    }\n    const id = await this.expenses.insertCategory({\n      company_id: this.companyId,\n      name: clean,\n      account_id: accountId ?? null,\n      is_active: 1,\n    });\n    return { id, name: clean };\n  }\n\n  async listExpenses(): Promise<ExpenseListRow[]> {\n    return this.expenses.listExpenses(this.companyId);\n  }\n\n  async createExpense(input: CreateExpenseInput): Promise<ExpenseResult> {\n    const companyId = input.companyId ?? this.companyId;\n    const amount = round2(input.amount);\n    if (amount.lessThanOrEqualTo(0)) {\n      throw new ValidationError(\"Amount must be greater than 0.\");\n    }\n    if (![\"CASH\", \"BANK\", \"CHEQUE\"].includes(input.paymentMethod)) {\n      throw new ValidationError(\"Invalid payment method.\");\n    }\n    if (!input.expenseDate) throw new ValidationError(\"Expense date is required.\");\n\n    const category = await this.expenses.findCategoryById(input.categoryId);\n    if (!category) throw new NotFoundError(`Expense category ${input.categoryId} not found.`);\n    if (!category.is_active) throw new ValidationError(\"Category is not active.\");\n\n    const resolver = new SystemAccountResolver(this.db, companyId);\n    const expenseAccountId =\n      category.account_id ?? (await resolver.idFor(SystemAccountCodes.GENERAL_ADMIN_EXPENSE ?? \"6000\"));\n    const paymentAccountId =\n      input.paymentMethod === \"CASH\"\n        ? await resolver.idFor(SystemAccountCodes.CASH_IN_HAND)\n        : await resolver.idFor(SystemAccountCodes.BANK_ACCOUNTS);\n\n    let voucherNumber = input.voucherNumber?.trim() || \"\";\n    if (voucherNumber) {\n      if (await this.expenses.voucherExists(voucherNumber, companyId)) {\n        throw new ConflictError(`Expense voucher '${voucherNumber}' already exists.`);\n      }\n    } else {\n      voucherNumber = await this.journal.nextVoucherNumber(companyId, \"EXPENSE_VOUCHER\");\n    }\n\n    return this.db.transaction(async () => {\n      const id = await this.expenses.insertExpense({\n        company_id: companyId,\n        voucher_number: voucherNumber,\n        category_id: category.id,\n        expense_date: input.expenseDate,\n        amount: toStorage(amount),\n        payment_method: input.paymentMethod,\n        bank_account_id: input.bankAccountId ?? null,\n        cheque_id: input.chequeId ?? null,\n        description: input.description ?? null,\n        created_by: input.createdBy ?? null,\n      });\n\n      const journalEntryId = await this.accounting.postJournalEntry({\n        voucherType: \"JOURNAL\",\n        entryDate: input.expenseDate,\n        lines: [\n          {\n            accountId: expenseAccountId,\n            debit: amount,\n            description: input.description ?? `Expense: ${category.name}`,\n          },\n          {\n            accountId: paymentAccountId,\n            credit: amount,\n            description: `Payment for: ${category.name}`,\n          },\n        ],\n        sourceTable: \"expenses\",\n        sourceId: id,\n        narration: `Expense voucher ${voucherNumber}: ${category.name}`,\n        companyId,\n        createdBy: input.createdBy ?? null,\n      });\n\n      return { id, voucherNumber, journalEntryId };\n    });\n  }\n}\n"
}

          def create_bank_account(
              self,
              bank_name: str,
              account_title: str,
              account_number: str,
              opening_balance: float = 0.0,
              branch_code: str | None = None,
              iban: str | None = None,
              company_id: int = 1,
          ) -> BankAccount:
              """Create a bank account with automatic Chart of Accounts entry."""
              # Validate inputs
              if not bank_name.strip():
                  raise ValidationError("Bank name is required.")
              if not account_title.strip():
                  raise ValidationError("Account title is required.")
              if not account_number.strip():
                  raise ValidationError("Account number is required.")
              if opening_balance < 0:
                  raise ValidationError("Opening balance cannot be negative.")
              
              # ✅ CHECK FOR DUPLICATE ACCOUNT NUMBER
              existing = self.account_repo.find_by_account_number(account_number.strip(), company_id)
              if existing:
                  raise ValidationError(f"Bank account number '{account_number}' already exists.")
      
              # Find or create Bank account in Chart of Accounts (code 1010)
              # All bank accounts link to this single COA entry for consolidated reporting
              bank_acc = self.accounting_repo.find_by_code("1010")
              if not bank_acc:
                  from services.account_service import AccountService
                  from models.enums import AccountType
                  acc_service = AccountService(self.db)
                  bank_acc = acc_service.create_account(
                      account_code="1010",
                      account_name="Bank Accounts",
                      account_type=AccountType.ASSET,
                      opening_balance=0,
                  )
                  account_id = bank_acc.id
              else:
                  account_id = bank_acc["id"]
      
              account = BankAccount(
                  bank_name=bank_name.strip(),
                  account_title=account_title.strip(),
                  account_number=account_number.strip(),
                  account_id=account_id,
                  opening_balance=opening_balance,
                  branch_code=branch_code,
                  iban=iban,
                  company_id=company_id,
              )
      
              with self.db.transaction():
                  account.id = self.account_repo.insert(account.to_dict())
      
                  # Post opening balance if > 0
                  if opening_balance > 0:
                      self._post_bank_balance(account.id, opening_balance, "Opening balance")
      
              logger.info("Created bank account: %s - %s", bank_name, account_title)
              return account
      
      
          def _post_bank_balance(self, bank_account_id: int, amount: float, description: str):
              """Post a journal entry for bank balance changes."""
              from accounting.system_accounts import SystemAccountCodes, SystemAccountResolver
              
              bank_account = self.account_repo.get_by_id(bank_account_id)
              if not bank_account:
                  raise ValidationError("Bank account not found.")
      
              # Get the Chart of Accounts bank account
              coa_bank = self.accounting_repo.get_by_id(bank_account["account_id"])
              if not coa_bank:
                  raise ValidationError("Bank account not found in Chart of Accounts.")
      
              # Use Retained Earnings (3100) for opening balances, consistent with AccountService
              resolver = SystemAccountResolver(self.db, bank_account["company_id"])
              equity_account_id = resolver.id_for(SystemAccountCodes.RETAINED_EARNINGS)
              if not equity_account_id:
                  raise ValidationError("Retained Earnings account (3100) not found.")

  "content": "import type { SqlDatabase } from \"../db/types.js\";\nimport { insertRow, type InsertData } from \"./base.js\";\n\nexport interface BankAccountRow {\n  id: number;\n  company_id: number;\n  account_id: number;\n  bank_name: string;\n  account_title: string;\n  account_number: string;\n  branch_code: string | null;\n  iban: string | null;\n  opening_balance: number;\n  is_active: number;\n  created_at: string;\n}\n\nexport interface BankTransactionRow {\n  id: number;\n  bank_account_id: number;\n  transaction_type: string;\n  amount: number;\n  transaction_date: string;\n  reference_no: string | null;\n  notes: string | null;\n  journal_entry_id: number | null;\n  created_at: string;\n}\n\nexport interface ChequeRow {\n  id: number;\n  company_id: number;\n  bank_account_id: number;\n  party_id: number | null;\n  cheque_number: string;\n  cheque_type: \"ISSUED\" | \"RECEIVED\";\n  amount: number;\n  cheque_date: string;\n  status: string;\n  cleared_date: string | null;\n  notes: string | null;\n}\n\nexport class BankingRepository {\n  constructor(private readonly db: SqlDatabase) {}\n\n  async findBankAccountByNumber(\n    accountNumber: string,\n    companyId = 1,\n  ): Promise<BankAccountRow | undefined> {\n    return this.db.get<BankAccountRow>(\n      \"SELECT * FROM bank_accounts WHERE account_number = ? AND company_id = ?\",\n      [accountNumber, companyId],\n    );\n  }\n\n  async insertBankAccount(data: InsertData): Promise<number> {\n    return insertRow(this.db, \"bank_accounts\", data);\n  }\n\n  async findBankAccountById(id: number): Promise<BankAccountRow | undefined> {\n    return this.db.get<BankAccountRow>(\"SELECT * FROM bank_accounts WHERE id = ?\", [id]);\n  }\n\n  async listBankAccounts(companyId = 1): Promise<BankAccountRow[]> {\n    return this.db.all<BankAccountRow>(\n      \"SELECT * FROM bank_accounts WHERE company_id = ? AND is_active = 1 ORDER BY bank_name\",\n      [companyId],\n    );\n  }\n\n  async insertTransaction(data: InsertData): Promise<number> {\n    return insertRow(this.db, \"bank_transactions\", data);\n  }\n\n  async listTransactions(companyId = 1, limit = 200): Promise<BankTransactionRow[]> {\n    return this.db.all<BankTransactionRow>(\n      `SELECT bt.* FROM bank_transactions bt\n       JOIN bank_accounts ba ON ba.id = bt.bank_account_id\n       WHERE ba.company_id = ?\n       ORDER BY bt.transaction_date DESC, bt.id DESC LIMIT ?`,\n      [companyId, limit],\n    );\n  }\n\n  async insertCheque(data: InsertData): Promise<number> {\n    return insertRow(this.db, \"cheques\", data);\n  }\n\n  async findChequeById(id: number): Promise<ChequeRow | undefined> {\n    return this.db.get<ChequeRow>(\"SELECT * FROM cheques WHERE id = ?\", [id]);\n  }\n\n  async listCheques(companyId = 1, status?: string): Promise<ChequeRow[]> {\n    return this.db.all<ChequeRow>(\n      \"SELECT * FROM cheques WHERE company_id = ?\" +\n        (status ? \" AND status = ?\" : \"\") +\n        \" ORDER BY cheque_date DESC, id DESC LIMIT 200\",\n      status ? [companyId, status] : [companyId],\n    );\n  }\n\n  async updateCheque(id: number, data: InsertData): Promise<void> {\n    const cols = Object.keys(data);\n    if (cols.length === 0) return;\n    const assignments = cols.map((c) => `${c} = ?`).join(\", \");\n    await this.db.run(`UPDATE cheques SET ${assignments} WHERE id = ?`, [\n      ...cols.map((c) => data[c] ?? null),\n      id,\n    ]);\n  }\n}\n"
}

opening balance:  Dr 1010  Cr Retained Earnings 3100 (OPENING)\n *   deposit:                             Dr 1010  Cr Cash 1000\n *   withdraw:                            Dr Cash 1000  Cr 1010\n *       description: \"Opening balance\",\n            },\n          ],\n          narration: `Bank account opening balance: ${bankName}`,\n          companyId,\n        });\n      }\n\n      const created = await this.banks.findBankAccountById(id);\n      return created!;\n    });\n  }\n\n  async deposit(input: BankMovementInput): Promise<{ id: number; journalEntryId: number }> {\n    return this.movement(input, \"DEPOSIT\");\n  }\n\n  async withdraw(input: BankMovementInput): Promise<{ id: number; journalEntryId: number }> {\n    return this.movement(input, \"WITHDRAWAL\");\n  }\n\n  private async movement(\n    input: BankMovementInput,\n    type: \"DEPOSIT\" | \"WITHDRAWAL\",\n  ): Promise<{ id: number; journalEntryId: number }> {\n    const amount = round2(input.amount);\n    if (amount.lessThanOrEqualTo(0)) throw new ValidationError(\"Amount must be greater than 0.\");\n    const account = await this.banks.findBankAccountById(input.bankAccountId);\n    if (!account) throw new NotFoundError(`Bank account ${input.bankAccountId} not found.`);\n\n    const resolver = new SystemAccountResolver(this.db, this.companyId);\n    const cashId = await resolver.idFor(SystemAccountCodes.CASH_IN_HAND);\n    const description = `${type === \"DEPOSIT\" ? \"Deposit\" : \"Withdrawal\"}${input.referenceNo ? ` - ${input.referenceNo}` : \"\"}`;\n\n    const lines: JournalLineInput[] =\n      type === \"DEPOSIT\"\n        ? credit: number; party_id: number | null }>(\n      `SELECT a.account_code, l.debit, l.credit, l.party_id\n       FROM journal_entry_lines l JOIN accounts a ON a.id = l.account_id\n       WHERE l.credit > 0 ORDER BY l.id DESC LIMIT 1`,\n    );\n    expect(lines[0]?.account_code).toBe(\"1010\");\n  });\n\n  it(\"refuses to clear an already-cleared cheque\", async () => {\n    const account = expect(banking.clearCheque(cheque.id)).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(ValidationError);\n  });\n\n  it(\"bounces a cheque by updating its status\", async () => {\n    const account = await banking.createBankAccount({\n      bankName: \"HBL\",\n      accountTitle: \"Main\",\n      accountNumber: \"4\",\n    });\n    const cheque = await banking.issueCheque({\n      bankAccountId: banking.listCheques(\"BOUNCED\");\n    expect(updated.map((c) => c.id)).toContain(cheque.id);\n  });\n});\n"

\"cheques\";\n\nexport default function BankingPage() {\n  const [tab, setTab] = useState<Tab>(\"accounts\");\n  const [accounts, setAccounts] = useState<BankAccount[]>([]);\n  const [transactions,
